# Synthetic protocol responses

`protocol-responses.json` is hand-authored public regression data. It contains
no provider output, internal endpoints, account identifiers or real user text.
It is not live gateway evidence.

The cases cover string, object and array instructions; choice ties and rounded
probability totals; exact and rounded weighted scores with legends; `noul` with
and without criteria; and multiple typed answers in one response. Existing HTTP
and invalid-response tests retain rejection and transport coverage.
